description: Defines the TimesheetColumn class within the OrangeHRM Time module, representing a column in a timesheet with a date and total hours.

classes.name: TimesheetColumn
classes.description: Represents a column in a timesheet with a specific date and total hours.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetColumn with a specific date.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with the timesheet column.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total hours recorded for the timesheet column.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total hours by a specified amount and returns the new total.
